#version 300 es
precision highp float;out vec4 result;void main(){result=vec4(float(gl_SampleID));}

#version 300 es
#extension GL_OES_sample_variables : require
#extension GL_OES_shader_multisample_interpolation : require
precision highp float;in vec3 ray;out vec4 result;void main(){result=vec4(interpolateAtSample(ray,gl_SampleID),1.0);}
